1.title: Lake Mead, the Nation’s Largest Reservoir, Is Smaller Than Ever
1.summary: Water levels in the reservoir, which sits behind the Hoover Dam, are at record lows. A continued drop would imperil water supplies for millions of people and cut electricity from the dam.

2.title: Michigan Senate Candidate, a Former Trump Critic, Shifts Toward Election Skepticism
2.summary: Mike Rogers, the Republican nominee, has suggested that further scrutiny of the 2020 election was warranted and that voting irregularities sank his first Senate bid two years ago.

3.title: Residents warned to brace for the worst as Canada wildfire rages out of control
3.summary: The Bald Range wildfire in British Columbia, still considered "out of control", has spread over 53 sq miles (136 sq km).

5.title: Evidence that South African special forces murdered top detective shared with BBC
5.summary: Frans Mathipa was shot while driving - we got access to the prosecution case against eight accused men.

6.title: Israel Rejects Trump’s 15-Point Plan to Disarm Hamas
6.summary: President Trump’s Board of Peace announced an agreement last month that aimed at Hamas’s giving up its weapons alongside an Israeli withdrawal from Gaza.
